title: New Drug Shows Strong Weight Loss Results for Diabetes Patients
subtitle: Recent clinical trials suggest a new medicine could help people with type 2 diabetes manage their weight and health more effectively.

summary.en: A new clinical trial called TRIUMPH-2 has tested a drug named retatrutide in patients with type 2 diabetes and obesity. The study found that participants lost significant amounts of weight over 80 weeks. Beyond weight loss, the drug also helped improve blood sugar levels and other health markers. Experts note that this drug works by targeting three different hormones in the body. While the results are promising, researchers emphasize that more work is needed to help those with diabetes reach their health goals.
summary.zh: 一項名為「TRIUMPH-2」的新臨床試驗針對患有第二型糖尿病與肥胖症的患者，測試了一種名為 retatrutide 的藥物。研究發現，參與者在 80 週內減去了顯著的體重。除了減重之外，該藥物還有助於改善血糖水準及其他健康指標。專家指出，此藥物的作用機制是鎖定體內三種不同的荷爾蒙。儘管結果令人期待，研究人員強調仍需更多努力，以協助糖尿病患者達成健康目標。

paragraphs.en: A new medical study has provided fresh hope for people living with both obesity and type 2 diabetes. According to MedPage Today, a large clinical trial known as TRIUMPH-2 has shown that a new drug called retatrutide can help patients lose a significant amount of weight. This is an important development because, historically, people with diabetes have found it harder to lose weight compared to those without the condition, regardless of whether they use medicine or have surgery.
paragraphs.zh: 一項新的醫學研究為同時患有肥胖症與第二型糖尿病的患者帶來了新的希望。根據醫學新聞網站 MedPage Today 的報導，一項名為「TRIUMPH-2」的大型臨床試驗顯示，一種名為 retatrutide 的新藥能協助患者減去顯著的體重。這是一項重要的進展，因為從歷史經驗來看，無論是透過藥物還是手術，糖尿病患者相較於非糖尿病患者，在減重方面往往面臨更大的困難。

paragraphs.en: The study followed 1,152 participants across 92 medical centers in eight countries. Over a period of 80 weeks, researchers tested different doses of the drug. The results were clear: those who took the highest dose of 12 mg lost an average of 18.8% of their body weight. In comparison, those who took a placebo—a pill with no medicine inside—lost only about 5.1%. These findings were recently shared at the European Association for the Study of Diabetes annual meeting and published in the medical journal The Lancet.
paragraphs.zh: 該研究追蹤了八個國家中九十二個醫療中心的 1,152 名參與者。在為期 80 週的期間內，研究人員測試了不同劑量的藥物。結果相當明確：服用最高劑量 12 毫克的受試者，平均減去了 18.8% 的體重。相較之下，服用安慰劑（即不含藥物成分的藥丸）的受試者僅減去了約 5.1%。這些研究發現近期已在歐洲糖尿病研究協會的年度會議上發表，並刊登於醫學期刊《刺胳針》(The Lancet)。

paragraphs.en: Juan P. Frias, a doctor from the Los Angeles Institute for Metabolic Research, explained why this drug is different from others currently on the market. He noted that while older drugs like semaglutide and tirzepatide have been successful, retatrutide works by engaging three different systems in the body. By targeting three specific hormones—GIP, GLP-1, and glucagon—the drug helps reduce appetite through several different pathways at once. Dr. Frias suggested that for people with type 2 diabetes, activating as many of these pathways as possible is key to achieving better results.
paragraphs.zh: 來自洛杉磯代謝研究中心的醫師胡安·弗里亞斯 (Juan P. Frias) 解釋了為何此藥物與目前市面上的其他藥物不同。他指出，雖然像司美格魯肽 (semaglutide) 和替爾泊肽 (tirzepatide) 等舊型藥物已取得成功，但 retatrutide 的運作機制是透過啟動體內三種不同的系統。藉由鎖定 GIP、GLP-1 與升糖素這三種特定的荷爾蒙，該藥物能同時透過多種路徑來抑制食慾。弗里亞斯醫師認為，對於第二型糖尿病患者而言，盡可能活化這些路徑是達成更佳治療效果的關鍵。

paragraphs.en: Beyond just losing weight, the trial showed that the drug helped improve other health markers. Many participants saw a significant drop in their HbA1c levels, which is a common test used to measure long-term blood sugar control. In fact, up to 40% of the people who took the drug reached a state called normoglycemia, where their blood sugar levels returned to a normal range. The study also reported improvements in other areas of heart and metabolic health, including smaller waist measurements and lower levels of fats in the blood, known as triglycerides.
paragraphs.zh: 除了減重之外，該試驗顯示此藥物有助於改善其他健康指標。許多參與者的糖化血色素 (HbA1c) 水準顯著下降，這是衡量長期血糖控制狀況的常用指標。事實上，高達 40% 的用藥者達到了「血糖正常化」的狀態，即血糖水準回歸至正常範圍。研究亦指出，受試者在心臟與代謝健康的其他領域也有所改善，包括腰圍縮小以及血液中的脂肪（即三酸甘油酯）含量降低。

paragraphs.en: Despite these positive results, researchers remain cautious. Dr. Frias pointed out that the weight loss seen in this study was still slightly lower than the results from a previous trial, called TRIUMPH-1, which looked at people who did not have diabetes. This confirms the ongoing challenge of treating weight issues in patients who also have diabetes. However, the study authors emphasized that there is a strong need for more effective weight-loss options for this group, and drugmakers are working hard to meet that demand.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管結果正面，研究人員仍保持謹慎。弗里亞斯醫師指出，本研究觀察到的減重幅度仍略低於先前針對非糖尿病患者進行的「TRIUMPH-1」試驗結果。這證實了在同時患有糖尿病的患者身上治療體重問題，仍是一項持續存在的挑戰。然而，研究作者強調，這類族群對於更有效的減重選擇有迫切需求，藥廠也正努力滿足此需求。

paragraphs.en: The success of retatrutide has already caused a stir outside of the medical community. MedPage Today reports that the drug’s ability to cause significant weight loss has led to a lot of attention on social media. This interest has even created a "gray market," where people are trying to buy the drug before it has been officially approved for public use. Experts warn that patients should only use such medications under the supervision of a doctor to ensure safety.
paragraphs.zh: retatrutide 的成功已在醫學界之外引起轟動。MedPage Today 報導稱，該藥物顯著的減重效果在社群媒體上引發了高度關注。這種興趣甚至催生了「灰色市場」，有些人試圖在藥物正式獲准公開使用前就先行購買。專家警告，患者應僅在醫師監督下使用此類藥物，以確保安全。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the medical community is closely watching how these new treatments will change the way doctors manage diabetes. While retatrutide is still an investigational therapy—meaning it is still being studied and is not yet available for general prescription—the results from TRIUMPH-2 are a major step forward. Other combinations of drugs, such as eloralintide mixed with tirzepatide, are also being tested to see if they can provide even better results. For now, patients and doctors alike are encouraged by the progress, as these new tools offer a new way to fight both obesity and the complications of diabetes.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，醫學界正密切關注這些新療法將如何改變醫師管理糖尿病的方式。雖然 retatrutide 目前仍屬於試驗性治療（意即仍在研究階段，尚未開放一般處方），但 TRIUMPH-2 的結果已是重大進展。其他藥物組合（例如 eloralintide 與替爾泊肽的混合使用）也正在進行測試，以觀察是否能提供更好的效果。目前，患者與醫師皆對此進展感到振奮，因為這些新工具為對抗肥胖症及糖尿病併發症提供了新的途徑。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To activate or involve a specific part or system to make it function.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 啟動、使參與；在此指藥物作用於身體系統。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見意思為「參與」或「吸引」，這裡指藥物啟動身體的特定系統。文中：retatrutide works by engaging three different systems in the body.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A state of excitement, public interest, or controversy.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 騷動、轟動、引起廣泛討論。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（攪拌），這裡作名詞，指引起大眾關注。文中：The success of retatrutide has already caused a stir outside of the medical community.

keyTerms.definitionEn: The trade of goods through distribution channels that are legal but unintended by the original manufacturer.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 灰色市場；指非正式、未經官方授權但非完全非法的交易管道。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個慣用語，指介於合法與非法之間的市場。文中：This interest has even created a "gray market," where people are trying to buy the drug before it has been officially approved for public use.

quiz.question: What was the average weight loss percentage for participants who took the 12 mg dose of retatrutide?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，研究結果顯示服用 12 mg 最高劑量的受試者平均減輕了 18.8% 的體重。選項 A 是安慰劑組的減重數據；選項 C 的 40% 是指達到正常血糖範圍（normoglycemia）的受試者比例，而非體重減輕比例；選項 D 的 80 則是試驗進行的週數，而非減重百分比。

quiz.question: Based on the article, why might treating obesity in patients with type 2 diabetes be more difficult than in those without the condition?

options.A: Patients with diabetes are unable to take any form of weight-loss medication.
options.B: The biological pathways in diabetic patients are completely immune to hormone-targeting drugs.
options.C: Even with effective drugs, diabetic patients may show slightly lower weight-loss results compared to non-diabetic patients.
options.D: Doctors are hesitant to prescribe new drugs to patients who have both obesity and diabetes.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第五段，Dr. Frias 指出在 TRIUMPH-2（糖尿病患者）中觀察到的減重效果，仍略低於 TRIUMPH-1（無糖尿病者）的結果，這證實了治療合併糖尿病的肥胖患者持續面臨挑戰。選項 A 與文章事實不符；選項 B 過度推論，文章並未說藥物無效，只是效果略有差異；選項 D 無法從文中推論，醫師反而是在積極尋求新的治療選項。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the phrase 'caused a stir' mean?
quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在第六段中，「caused a stir」指的是引起了廣泛的關注、騷動或討論。文章提到該藥物在社群媒體上引發了大量注意，甚至導致「灰市」（gray market）的出現，這顯示其影響力與爭議性。選項 B 是 stir 的字面意思（攪拌），在此處不適用；選項 C 與 D 雖然與藥物有關，但並非該片語在此處的特定含義。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article regarding retatrutide?

options.A: The drug has been fully approved for public sale in all countries.
options.B: The drug is the only treatment currently available for type 2 diabetes.
options.C: The drug is a promising, though still experimental, development for treating obesity in diabetic patients.
options.D: Social media interest has made the drug safer for public use without medical supervision.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文整體主旨是在介紹 retatrutide 這項臨床試驗的進展，說明它如何透過多重機制幫助糖尿病患者減重並改善代謝健康，同時也強調它目前仍處於調查階段（investigational therapy）。選項 A 與文章提到「尚未正式核准」矛盾；選項 B 忽略了文章提到的其他舊藥（如 semaglutide）；選項 D 與文章中專家警告「應在醫師監督下使用」的立場完全相反。
